subject: Retainer consolidation, seat revision & latency banding proposal
messages:
From: Lily Chen <lily@stargazer.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating retainers + tighter latency targets

Team —

We're approaching renewal for our three regional retainers (US / EU / APAC) and want to simplify to a single enterprise retainer. Primary asks from our side:

- Consolidate the three retainers into one annual enterprise retainer covering global traffic.
- Update seat counts: move from 12 standard seats to 20 premium seats (higher response SLA / faster escalation).
- Tighten latency SLOs: aim for a 99th percentile global SLO (we're targeting lower variance). We expect a proposal with banded targets and crediting logic.
- Pre-authorized monthly burst credits (we run spikes during product launches).

Can you put together a commercial + operational sketch and sample SLA addendum? Also need a short ops/runbook (oncall, escalation windows, telemetry access) for our platform team.

Procurement will loop in formally after we agree high-level terms.

Thanks,
Lily Chen
Head of Infrastructure — Stargazer AI
Lily Chen
+1 415-555-0119

Attachments: none in this message
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lily Chen <lily@stargazer.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Consolidating retainers + tighter latency targets

Thanks Lily — this is doable and thanks for the clear asks. High-level response and next steps below: 

1) Commercial approach:
   - Consolidation into a single annual enterprise retainer covering global traffic. One invoice, one SLA addendum.
   - Seat revision: quote for 20 premium seats with stepped discounts if Stargazer commits to a 12-month minimum spend.
   - Burst credits: propose a pool of pre-paid burst credits (tokenized GPU-hours) that can be consumed monthly with rollover rules.

2) SLA / latency banding suggestion (initial):
   - P50 target: <40ms
   - P95 target: <120ms
   - P99 target: <300ms (global, measured at service edge — we can propose region-specific tails if you want tighter per-region SLOs)
   - Miss crediting: automated sliding-scale credits tied to severity and exceeded window (we'll attach a draft chart).

3) Ops / runbook:
   - We'll produce a short runbook covering: oncall roster (primary + secondary), escalation matrix, expected MTTR SLA for infra incidents, required telemetry (traces + token-level latency).

4) Compliance & procurement:
   - We'll prepare an SLA addendum and a mutual action plan (MAP) and share a doc with the track changes for commercial/legal.

I'll attach an initial MPA draft for internal review (Stargazer_MPA_v1.pdf). Ben — can you outline required telemetry/alerting hooks? Marissa — I'll need pricing bands (seat / retainer / burst credits) to propose back.

If this looks fine to you, let's schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk through the MAP and SLA addendum.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: Stargazer_MPA_v1.pdf (draft MAP, commercial sketch)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lily Chen <lily@stargazer.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Consolidating retainers + tighter latency targets

Rishi / Lily — quick ops notes from my side: 

- For a global 99p target we need to be explicit about measurement points (edge vs. origin). We recommend measuring from the service edge plus a regional breakdown (US/EU/APAC) so we can isolate network egress vs. runtime tail.
- Latency banding (suggestion for the chart in the SLA addendum):
  * Green: P99 < 150ms -> no credit
  * Amber: P99 150–300ms -> partial credit (0.5% of monthly retainer per breach window)
  * Red: P99 > 300ms -> full credit escalation (1.5% + remediation plan)
- Oncall / runbook items: the runbook should include request-response times, sample triage playbook, and a lightweight dashboard filter for Stargazer keys so your SREs can see token-level performance.
- Telemetry: please confirm you can share a 72-hour sample trace set and a spike window from the last launch so we can tune batching/kv-cache settings.

Happy to draft the runbook skeleton — assigning to myself for an initial pass.

Ben Carter
Director, Technical Customer Success — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lily Chen <lily@stargazer.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T10:50:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Consolidating retainers + tighter latency targets

Lily — thanks. Commercial bullets from Sales Ops: 

- Term: propose annual with an auto-renew, 12-month minimum committed spend to lock in seat pricing.
- Seat pricing: will provide two-band quote (20 premium seats and a 30-seat commit option with stepped discount).
- Dedicated capacity / throughput: include a commit tier for dedicated capacity (if Stargazer wants guaranteed throughput we need a capacity reservation and associated uplift).
- Credits & credits governance: propose monthly burst credit pool + one emergency top-up per year subject to usage review.

I'll add these to the MAP and share a working copy: MAP_Stargazer_shared.docx (live doc). For legal: once you accept the MAP we'll produce an SLA addendum and SOW.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call tomorrow 10:00 AM PT to align on the MAP + runbook owners. Lily, does that work?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks — 10:00 AM PT tomorrow works for us. Quick clarifications: 

- Stargazer prefers region-aware P99 targets: we'll accept a slightly higher global P99 if you can provide per-region P99s that meet stricter thresholds (we'll propose target numbers in the call).
- On burst credits: we want rollover up to one month and an emergency top-up that can be approved by our infra director.
- Procurement will need a DocuSign-ready SLA addendum + SOW; please include a software classification appendix for regulatory review.

Please send a calendar invite and the DocuSign placeholder link so procurement can prepare.

Lily Chen
Head of Infrastructure — Stargazer AI
